## About

- Best practices within structural equation modeling for using dyadic longitudinal data to model relationship development and couples’ long-term outcomes 
- Development and maintenance of positive romantic relationships in adolescence and early adulthood, including romantic relationship formation (mate selection, romantic socialization, etc.), emotional and physical intimacy, fostering attachment security, and relational/individual outcomes
